AccountBusinessHours.description:
An account and its own schedule, when it has one (``override``); otherwise the
workspace's applies.
AccountBusinessHours.title: AccountBusinessHours

AccountMetricFigure.description:
A metric for the period and, when asked, the period before. ``change_pct`` is
(current - previous) / previous x 100 to one decimal, computed here: None when either side is
unknown, the previous value is 0, or the periods aren't comparable.
AccountMetricFigure.title: AccountMetricFigure

AccountMetrics.description:
GET …/analytics/account-metrics: an account's (or every account's) figures for a period,
optionally against another. ``comparable`` is False when the two periods differ in length: the
figures are still given, but no change is computed.
AccountMetrics.title: AccountMetrics

ActivityAction.description: The one thing to do about it: a link inside the workspace ("/settings/connections").
ActivityAction.title: ActivityAction

ActivityRetry.description:
Where a safe retry goes: the web posts to the message's retry route, or the webhook
delivery's replay route, with ``target_id``.
ActivityRetry.title: ActivityRetry

AddressIn.description: Where to deliver. Every part is optional (digital orders have none); it is saved as given.
AddressIn.title: AddressIn

AgentApproval.description: A write waiting for a person: exactly what will happen (recipients, text, scope, count).
AgentApproval.title: AgentApproval

AgentApprovalList.description: Soonest to expire first; ``next_cursor`` fetches more.
AgentApprovalList.title: AgentApprovalList

AgentPermissions.description:
Per-capability switches (models/agent.AgentCapability), all off until an owner or admin
turns them on (R2). A key missing from the stored row reads as its default
(``{**DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS, **row.permissions}``).
AgentPermissions.title: AgentPermissions

AgentPolicy.description: The workspace's agent mode, switches and limits. R1: always read_only, all off.
AgentPolicy.title: AgentPolicy

AgentPolicyUpdate.description: PUT …/agent/policy (R2): the whole policy. ``autonomous`` is refused until R3 (409).
AgentPolicyUpdate.title: AgentPolicyUpdate

AgentRun.description:
A run in the history and a thread's exchanges (FR-AGT-01, FR-AGT-07); also the 202 answer
of POST …/agent/runs.
AgentRun.title: AgentRun

AgentRunCreate.description: POST …/agent/runs: a question in plain language (English, Hindi or Hinglish).
AgentRunCreate.title: AgentRunCreate

AgentRunDetail.description: GET …/agent/runs/{run_id}: the run with every step (TR-AGT-08).
AgentRunDetail.title: AgentRunDetail

AgentStep.description: One tool call, condition or report (TR-AGT-08), for the live steps and run history.
AgentStep.title: AgentStep

AgentThread.description: An Ask panel thread: the caller's runs that share context.
AgentThread.title: AgentThread

AgentThreadList.description: Most recent activity first; ``next_cursor`` fetches older threads.
AgentThreadList.title: AgentThreadList

AiDecision.description:
Why the AI did or did not reply (FR-SUG-04): the popover on an AI-sent bubble and the
escalation banner.
AiDecision.title: AiDecision

AiDecisionFeedback.description: POST …/ai-decisions/{id}/feedback: "bad" = should not have sent; null clears it.
AiDecisionFeedback.title: AiDecisionFeedback

AiReplyStep.description:
An AI reply from the knowledge base (T5.8), or a hand-off when it can't answer. It ends
the flow.
AiReplyStep.title: AiReplyStep

AiSettings.description: FR-KB-04 brand voice, FR-SUG-06 escalation phrases, FR-SUG-05 takeover period.
AiSettings.title: AiSettings

AnalysisCorrection.description: PATCH …/message-analyses/{id} (FR-AI-04): at least one of the two.
AnalysisCorrection.title: AnalysisCorrection

AnswerRef.description: A record an answer used (FR-AGT-01): ``[n]`` in the answer is item n of answer_refs.
AnswerRef.title: AnswerRef

ApiKeyWithKey.description: Create only: the key itself, shown this once. Only its hash is kept.
ApiKeyWithKey.title: ApiKeyWithKey

ApprovalApprove.description:
Approve as shown, or with edited arguments (Edit): the edit replaces the payload and is
checked by the gateway again (TR-AGT-04).
ApprovalApprove.title: ApprovalApprove

ApprovalEvent.description: One line of an approval's audit trail (GR-36): who did what, and when.
ApprovalEvent.title: ApprovalEvent

ApprovalOutcome.description:
What approving did (GR-36). ``ok`` false: the service refused it, nothing was saved, and
the approval is still pending so the member can edit it or reject it.
ApprovalOutcome.title: ApprovalOutcome

AskStep.description:
A question whose answer is checked and saved: free text to a custom field, an email or a
phone to the contact (or a custom field of that type). An answer that doesn't fit gets
``retry_text`` until ``tries`` run out, then the flow goes on at ``on_skip`` (GR-14: the editor
makes that the same step as ``next`` unless the author picks another).

``consent`` adds a marketing question once the answer is saved: Yes or No quick replies (or
those words typed), recorded in contact_consents with the messages as evidence.
``confirm_text`` is sent after the answer is saved (and the consent answered); blank sends
nothing. Blank ``retry_text`` and ``consent_text`` use the default copy in engine.py.
AskStep.title: AskStep

Assign.description:
Give the conversation to a member (GR-20): a chosen ``member``, the next available member
in turn (``round_robin``, whatever the workspace's own round-robin setting), or ``nobody``
(clears the assignment). The member is told, as for any assignment.
Assign.title: Assign

Assignable.description:
A member who can be given a conversation. Any member may list them (the picker), so there
is no email here: the name is the member's, else the part of their email before the @.
Assignable.title: Assignable

Assignee.description:
The member who has a conversation (GR-20). The name is the member's at the time of the
response; an assignee with no name shows their email's local part on the web.
Assignee.title: Assignee

AssigneeUpdate.description: PUT …/conversations/{id}/assignee. ``user_id`` null takes the assignment away.
AssigneeUpdate.title: AssigneeUpdate

AutomationCreate.description: A draft, blank or from a template (FR-AUT-12).
AutomationCreate.title: AutomationCreate

AutomationDefinition.description:
PUT …/automations/{id}: the whole editable definition (autosaved, F-11). Drafts may be
incomplete; activation checks completeness.
AutomationDefinition.title: AutomationDefinition

AutomationDraftPrefill.description:
The automation editor, new and unsaved, filled with a draft (F-11). Field names and rules
are AutomationDefinition's (schemas/automations.py); the editor saves it like any draft.
AutomationDraftPrefill.title: AutomationDraftPrefill

AutomationStats.description: FR-AUT-16 / UX-SCR-12, for the last 7 or 30 days.
AutomationStats.title: AutomationStats

AutomationTestResult.description: What would happen; nothing is sent (T4.3).
AutomationTestResult.title: AutomationTestResult

AutomationsSummary.description: UX-SCR-02's figures strip, for the last 7 days.
AutomationsSummary.title: AutomationsSummary

Baseline.description: What the post was compared with, as requested and as found.
Baseline.title: Baseline

BestTimeDay.description:
One weekday's suggestion. ``local_time`` is None when the account's history is too thin for
this day (``posts`` is how many posts the suggested hour is based on, else 0).
BestTimeDay.title: BestTimeDay

BestTimes.description:
GET …/social-accounts/{id}/best-times: a suggested posting time per weekday, worked out
from the account's own posts (never by an AI model). ``enough_history`` is false, and every
day empty, until the account has ``min_posts`` posts with known engagement. Cached for a few
hours.
BestTimes.title: BestTimes

BranchStep.description: The first rule that holds picks the next step; none does, ``otherwise``.
BranchStep.title: BranchStep

BreakdownMetric.description:
One account's count for the week against the week before, with a weekly series. A value
the platform can't give is None and ``unavailable`` says why (``insights_not_granted``,
``no_readings``); a count is never None for that reason.
BreakdownMetric.title: BreakdownMetric

BroadcastAvailability.description:
Whether the web shows broadcasts at all (the BROADCASTS_ENABLED setting), and what the plan
allows.
BroadcastAvailability.title: BroadcastAvailability

BroadcastDraft.description: What a broadcast says and who gets it; the preview takes only this.
BroadcastDraft.title: BroadcastDraft

BroadcastStart.description: Send now, or at ``scheduled_at`` (at least a minute from now).
BroadcastStart.title: BroadcastStart

BroadcastUpdate.description:
Change a draft or a scheduled broadcast. Everything is optional; a changed number,
segment or template must still fit the others.
BroadcastUpdate.title: BroadcastUpdate

BulkScheduledPostRequest.description:
POST …/scheduled-posts/bulk (FR-PUB-14): ``shift`` moves each post by ``shift_minutes``
(required, not 0), ``unschedule`` returns scheduled posts to draft, ``delete`` deletes.
BulkScheduledPostRequest.title: BulkScheduledPostRequest

BulkSkipped.description:
A post the action could not apply to, and why (``conflict``: publishing started or
published; ``validation_error``: the shifted time would be less than 5 minutes away).
BulkSkipped.title: BulkSkipped

BulkTagsUpdate.description:
Name the contacts (up to 500) or give a filter for everything that matches it (up to the
service's cap); not both.
BulkTagsUpdate.title: BulkTagsUpdate

BusinessHours.description:
A schedule with all seven days (a closed day has no ranges). ``configured`` is false until
one was saved. ``open_now`` is null while it is off.
BusinessHours.title: BusinessHours

BusinessHoursUpdate.description:
The whole schedule. ``enabled`` with no ranges is refused. ``away_message`` is sent once
per closed window when ``away_enabled`` (it may use ``{first_name}`` like a saved reply).
``auto_mode``: Auto mode answers always (today's behaviour) or only while closed.
BusinessHoursUpdate.title: BusinessHoursUpdate

Calendar.description:
GET …/calendar: the range's items, ``start`` to ``end`` (dates in the workspace time zone,
both included). Layers not asked for come back empty.
Calendar.title: Calendar

CalendarAccount.description:
The right rail (UX-SCR-04): posts published in the last 24 hours against the account's
publishing limit, and its next free posting time (None without posting times).
CalendarAccount.title: CalendarAccount

CalendarMessage.description: A scheduled DM on the Messages layer (FR-SMS-02), with its account for the filter.
CalendarMessage.title: CalendarMessage

CalendarSlot.description:
A free posting time (FR-PUB-09): a dashed queue slot in the Week view. A slot is free when
no scheduled or publishing post of the account is within 30 minutes of it.
CalendarSlot.title: CalendarSlot

CaptionRequest.title: CaptionRequest

ChecklistItem.description:
One line of the checklist (FR-PUB-10). A check that passes appears once; a failing check
appears once per failing element, ``field`` naming it (for example ``asset_ids.2``), so each
item links to its fix.
ChecklistItem.title: ChecklistItem

CheckoutRequest.description: POST …/billing/checkout (F-15). Max is R2: "max" is refused with 422 until then.
CheckoutRequest.title: CheckoutRequest

CheckoutSession.description:
Where to send the browser: Dodo's hosted checkout. Coming back to
/w/{slug}/settings/billing?checkout=return changes nothing by itself; the plan changes when
Dodo's signed webhook arrives (FR-BIL-02).
CheckoutSession.title: CheckoutSession

CollaboratorResult.description:
One collaborator's invite on a published post (FR-PUB-07). A collaborator can't be changed
after publishing.
CollaboratorResult.title: CollaboratorResult

Comment.description: A comment row (UX-SCR-05). Replies to other comments carry the parent's platform id.
Comment.title: Comment

CommentCounts.description:
The Comments nav badge: comments waiting for a reply (services/comments/queries.py
``comment_counts`` has the rule).
CommentCounts.title: CommentCounts

CommentPrivateReply.description:
The one private reply Instagram allows per comment: a DM in the commenter's
conversation.
CommentPrivateReply.title: CommentPrivateReply

CommentPublicReply.description: The account's public reply under the comment (a member's or an automation's).
CommentPublicReply.title: CommentPublicReply

CommentReplyCreate.description: POST …/comments/{comment_id}/reply: a public reply under the comment.
CommentReplyCreate.title: CommentReplyCreate

CommentReplyPrefill.description: The post detail's reply box on one comment (FR-CMT-04).
CommentReplyPrefill.title: CommentReplyPrefill

CommentStats.description:
A post's comment counts (``media_items.comment_stats``): ``total`` grows as comments arrive,
the rest are recounted by the analysis job.

``positive + neutral + negative`` counts analysed comments that are not spam; ``spam`` counts
analysed spam. ``analysed`` counts every comment no longer waiting: analysed, or skipped (AI
analysis off, AI credits used up, beyond the plan's posts, empty), so while ``analysed <
total`` the page shows "Analysing {analysed} of {total} comments" (FR-CMT-02) and the progress
always ends. Deleted comments are not counted.
CommentStats.title: CommentStats

Consent.description: The current state for one channel: the latest record.
Consent.title: Consent

ConsentCreate.description:
A member records consent the customer gave elsewhere (a form, in person), or its
withdrawal. The note says how it was given; it's the evidence.
ConsentCreate.title: ConsentCreate

ContactCondition.description: Whether the contact's email or phone is known.
ContactCondition.title: ContactCondition

ContactFilterOut.description:
A saved filter as returned. A separate class from the request's, so the API description
keeps one name for each (a model used both ways with defaults would be split in two).
ContactFilterOut.title: ContactFilterOut

ContactFilterSpec.description:
The contacts list's filter as a body (a saved segment, a bulk tag on everything that
matches). The same keys, rules and limits as the list's query string.
ContactFilterSpec.title: ContactFilterSpec

ContactPatch.description:
Only what is sent changes. A ``name`` is the team's; ``use_platform_name`` goes back to the
platform's. ``fields`` merges: a key set to null is removed. An email or
phone set here is marked as entered by a member and not verified.
ContactPatch.title: ContactPatch

ContactRecord.description: One contact with what the business knows about them.
ContactRecord.title: ContactRecord

ConversationEntry.description:
How the conversation began (GR-01): organic, an entry link (its ref), an ad (its id and,
when Meta gave it, title), an ice breaker (GR-11) or another referral.
ConversationEntry.title: ConversationEntry

CostEstimate.description:
Meta's rate card times the people to send to. Information, not a charge: the business pays
Meta directly (PD-3). The card is typed in by hand and unverified.
CostEstimate.title: CostEstimate

DaySchedule.description:
``day`` is 0 (Monday) to 6 (Sunday). No ranges: closed all day. Ranges don't overlap; a
range doesn't cross midnight (open late: end at 24:00, then start the next day at 00:00).
DaySchedule.title: DaySchedule

DaySpan.description: Calendar days in the workspace's zone, both included.
DaySpan.title: DaySpan

DelayStep.description:
A pause, at most 23 hours, so what follows can still go inside the 24-hour reply window
(a send the window no longer allows ends the run instead).
DelayStep.title: DelayStep

DigestUnsubscribed.description:
POST /v1/digest/unsubscribe?token=…: the digest is off for that member of that workspace
(idempotent). The page names the workspace and links to Settings → Notifications.
DigestUnsubscribed.title: DigestUnsubscribed

EmbeddedSignup.description:
What the page receives from Meta's Embedded Signup v4: the FB.login code, and the ids from
the session-info message when it arrived. A missing id is looked up with the business token
(the shared WhatsApp Business Account from debug_token, its number from phone_numbers).
EmbeddedSignup.title: EmbeddedSignup

EntryLink.description:
``url`` is the link to share (and what the QR code holds). ``opened_conversations`` counts
conversations that began from the link, ``runs`` the automation runs they led to.
EntryLink.title: EntryLink

EntryLinkCreate.description:
``code`` is the ?ref= value; leave it out and one is made. It can't be changed later, so
printed QR codes keep working.
EntryLinkCreate.title: EntryLinkCreate

EntryRule.description:
What starts the sequence for a contact: a lead captured (any, or an email, a phone or an
answer), a tag added (``tag_id``), a reply to a WhatsApp broadcast (any, or one), or the lead
moving into a stage (``stage``).
EntryRule.title: EntryRule

ExcludePath.description: POST …/excluded-paths: pages at this path or below it are removed and not crawled again.
ExcludePath.title: ExcludePath

ExtraMetrics.description:
Figures only some posts have, kept apart from ``PostMetrics`` (which every post shares and
compares): an Instagram Story's replies and its taps and swipes through the Story, and the
clicks on a Facebook Page post. None: not given for this post or not read yet.
ExtraMetrics.title: ExtraMetrics

FacebookConnectPages.description: The Pages to connect, picked from the list the same nonce returned.
FacebookConnectPages.title: FacebookConnectPages

FacebookPagesRequest.description: The nonce the OAuth callback put in the Connections page's URL (?facebook=…).
FacebookPagesRequest.title: FacebookPagesRequest

FieldDefinitionPatch.description: A field's key and type never change: values are stored by key and validated by type.
FieldDefinitionPatch.title: FieldDefinitionPatch

FirstCommentResult.description:
FR-PUB-11 for one account: the first comment is posted right after the post; a failure
leaves the post published and is shown on it.
FirstCommentResult.title: FirstCommentResult

Flow.description:
GET and PUT …/automations/{id}/flow. ``source`` says how it was made: ``legacy`` is
compiled from the automation's message settings (the current editor), ``flow`` was saved as
a flow.
Flow.title: Flow

FlowButton.description:
A link button: a https address, or the account's own Instagram profile (``profile``,
the follow nudge's "View profile").
FlowButton.title: FlowButton

FlowDefinition.description: ``start`` is the first step; a step without a next ends the flow.
FlowDefinition.title: FlowDefinition

FlowPreviewStep.description: One step of a flow's dry run, as the contact would meet it.
FlowPreviewStep.title: FlowPreviewStep

FollowsCondition.description: Whether they follow the account, read when the step runs; unknown counts as neither.
FollowsCondition.title: FollowsCondition

FulfilOrder.description:
Mark a paid order shipped. ``note`` is shown on the order and in the default message
(a courier and tracking number, say).
FulfilOrder.title: FulfilOrder

FunnelStep.title: FunnelStep

GoogleConnectComplete.description: The nonce the OAuth callback put in the Integrations page's URL (?google=…).
GoogleConnectComplete.title: GoogleConnectComplete

HandOff.description: The conversation goes to Needs you, and the AI stops replying in it.
HandOff.title: HandOff

HashtagGroupCreate.description:
A name unique in the workspace ignoring case (else 422 on ``name``); 1 to 30 hashtags
(duplicates collapse).
HashtagGroupCreate.title: HashtagGroupCreate

HashtagGroupList.description: Every group of the workspace, by name.
HashtagGroupList.title: HashtagGroupList

HashtagSuggestionRequest.description:
POST …/ai/hashtags: hashtags for the caption, leaving out those already in it and in
``exclude``; costs AI credits (caption_generation).
HashtagSuggestionRequest.title: HashtagSuggestionRequest

IceBreakersUpdate.description: The whole list, in order. An empty list removes the starters.
IceBreakersUpdate.title: IceBreakersUpdate

InboxCounts.description: The Inbox nav badge (FR-INB-04) and view chips.
InboxCounts.title: InboxCounts

InstagramConnectComplete.description: The nonce the OAuth callback put in the Connections page's URL (?instagram=…, X-1).
InstagramConnectComplete.title: InstagramConnectComplete

InvitationCreate.description: Owners invite admins or agents; admins invite agents only.
InvitationCreate.title: InvitationCreate

KnowledgeSourceCreate.description:
POST …/knowledge-sources. FAQ: question + body (title = question). Note: title + body.
Web page: url (SEC-09). File: file_asset_id of an uploaded raw asset (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD up to
10 MB). ``gap_id`` answers a knowledge gap (FR-KB-06).
KnowledgeSourceCreate.title: KnowledgeSourceCreate

KnowledgeTestResult.description: FR-KB-03: the drafted answer with the sources it used, or "Not in your knowledge".
KnowledgeTestResult.title: KnowledgeTestResult

LeadListVisual.description: Leads waiting for a reply, best score first (list_contacts with awaiting_reply, VIS-08).
LeadListVisual.title: LeadListVisual

LeadRow.description: One lead. ``name`` is the customer's own text: render it as text.
LeadRow.title: LeadRow

LeadStageCondition.description: Whether the contact's lead stage (GR-18) is any of ``stages``, read when the step runs.
LeadStageCondition.title: LeadStageCondition

LeadWeek.description: Leads that reached a stage in the week starting ``week_start`` (a Monday, UTC).
LeadWeek.title: LeadWeek

LinkedAutomation.description: A comment automation scoped to this post (FR-AUT-18, the composer's Automation step).
LinkedAutomation.title: LinkedAutomation

MarkPaid.description:
A payment a member received by hand (UPI has no webhook): the customer's reference, if they
shared one, and the amount in minor units when it is less than what is left to pay (blank:
all of it).
MarkPaid.title: MarkPaid

MemberRolePatch.description: Admin or agent. Ownership moves only through the transfer route.
MemberRolePatch.title: MemberRolePatch

MetricComparison.description: One metric of the post against the baseline at the same age.
MetricComparison.title: MetricComparison

MetricComparisonVisual.description: The current period against another, a card per metric (compare_periods).
MetricComparisonVisual.title: MetricComparisonVisual

MetricDelta.description:
One card of a comparison. Every figure and ``change_pct`` come from the analytics
service; ``tone`` is the metric's rule (more unfollows is bad), not the model's.
MetricDelta.title: MetricDelta

NoticeIn.description:
A message to the customer about an order's new status, sent on the order's conversation.
``message`` replaces the default wording. On WhatsApp after the 24-hour window an approved
utility template (name and language) carries it; without one it can't be sent.
NoticeIn.title: NoticeIn

NoticeOut.description: What happened to the message asked for with a status change: sent, or why not.
NoticeOut.title: NoticeOut

NotificationPreferences.description:
GET and PUT …/notification-preferences: the signed-in member's settings in this
workspace (workspace_members.notification_prefs). PUT sends the whole object and gets it
back. Fields are required both ways, so the request and response share one schema.
NotificationPreferences.title: NotificationPreferences

OrderEdit.description:
Change an order that is a draft or waiting for payment. Lines are replaced when given (and
re-priced from the catalogue now); the address and the note are replaced when given (an empty
note clears it). ``payment``, when given, sends a new payment request straight after, which
is what replaces a link the edit made useless.
OrderEdit.title: OrderEdit

Overview.description:
GET …/overview (FR-HOME-01, UX-SCR-01). Flows cover ``current`` (the range: 7 or 30 local
days up to and including today, or the custom ``from``..``to``) and ``previous`` (as many days
just before it); states are as of now.
Overview.title: Overview

OverviewEngagement.description: The mean engagement rate of the most commented posts that have one (``posts`` of them).
OverviewEngagement.title: OverviewEngagement

OverviewGap.description:
The open knowledge gap asked most recently: Home's View thread and Train AI. ``question``
is the customer's newest example message (the topic when there is none); the conversation
and message are where it came from, None for a comment's gap or a deleted message.
OverviewGap.title: OverviewGap

OverviewPeriod.description:
One period's flows (services/overview_stats.py has the definitions, shared with the weekly
digest): local days ``since`` to ``until``, both included, in the workspace's time zone.
Percentages are 0 to 100 with one decimal, None when there is nothing to divide.
OverviewPeriod.title: OverviewPeriod

OverviewPost.description:
One of the posts with the most comments in the period; ``stats`` is the post's own
comment split, as on the Comments page.
OverviewPost.title: OverviewPost

OwnershipTransfer.description:
Hand the workspace to another member. The previous owner becomes an admin. Type the
workspace's name to confirm.
OwnershipTransfer.title: OwnershipTransfer

PaymentItem.description: One line of an order a payment step makes: a product (and variant, when it has some).
PaymentItem.title: PaymentItem

PaymentOut.description:
One Dodo payment (§5.8 payments), as upserted from payment.* webhooks. ``invoice_url`` is
Dodo's own (never constructed); ``failure_reason`` is Dodo's reason for a failed payment.
PaymentOut.title: PaymentOut

PaymentStep.description:
Ask the customer to pay: make an order and send the payment link (Razorpay) or UPI request.
``source`` ``items`` orders the chosen ``items`` at the catalogue's prices when the step runs;
``draft`` uses the conversation's latest order that isn't paid yet (a member's draft, or the
customer's WhatsApp cart). ``intro`` is a line of your own above the payment message.
PaymentStep.title: PaymentStep

PeriodFigure.description:
One metric over one period. ``value`` is None when it isn't known (``unavailable`` says
why), never 0. With gaps it sums the days that have a reading: ``days_known`` of
``days_total``.
PeriodFigure.title: PeriodFigure

PlanOffer.description:
One plan for the pricing page and the upgrade dialog: its entitlements (billing/plans.py)
and, for a paid plan, its price from Dodo (cached 1 h; null when Dodo can't be reached).
PlanOffer.title: PlanOffer

PolishRequest.description:
POST …/conversations/{id}/polish (C-063): the member's draft reply. ``tone`` overrides the
brand voice's tone for this rewrite.
PolishRequest.title: PolishRequest

PolishResult.description:
The polished draft: the same language, meaning and roughly the length, with no fact,
number, link or promise the draft didn't have. Nothing is stored or sent.
PolishResult.title: PolishResult

PortalSession.description: Dodo's customer portal (payment method, invoices; FR-BIL-04), opened in a new tab.
PortalSession.title: PortalSession

PostAsset.description:
One image or video of the post (§5.10), in order. ``id`` is the media asset's id: the
composer sends these ids back, reordered, in ``asset_ids``.
PostAsset.title: PostAsset

PostComparison.description:
GET …/analytics/posts/{post_id}/compare (TR-AGT-05; agent-architecture §6 "Fair
comparison"): the post against its account's earlier posts at the same age.

``age`` is the window compared, chosen as in PostPerformance. Posts published before the
account was connected have no early snapshots, so they join a baseline only at ages they have:
``baseline_size`` counts the posts actually compared. ``enough_history`` is False below
MIN_COMPARABLE_POSTS; the UI and the agent then say there is not enough history and draw no
conclusion.
PostComparison.title: PostComparison

PostDetail.description:
GET …/posts/{post_id} (FR-CMT-04): the post, its counts and sentiment split (``stats``),
the summary of two or three sentences and the topics, largest first.
PostDetail.title: PostDetail

PostMetrics.description:
FR-ANL-02's figures at one age. ``engagement_rate`` = (likes + comments + shares + saves)
÷ reach, as a percentage, at the same age; only when reach is known.
PostMetrics.title: PostMetrics

PostPerformance.description:
GET …/analytics/posts/{post_id}/performance: one post's figures at an age.

``age`` is the age the figures are at: the requested one or, when the post is younger, the
latest window it has reached (``requested_age`` then differs and the UI says so). Without
``age`` in the request, the latest window the post has reached is used.
PostPerformance.title: PostPerformance

PostRef.description: A post an automation is scoped to: a synced post, or a scheduled one not yet published.
PostRef.title: PostRef

PostSummary.description: A synced post: the automation post picker (P4) and the Comments grid (FR-CMT-03).
PostSummary.title: PostSummary

PostTopic.description:
One of a post's topic labels (TR-AI-11): the model merges the most frequent comment topics
into at most 6 labels; code counts each label's comments and their sentiment.
PostTopic.title: PostTopic

PostingSlotsUpdate.description:
PUT …/social-accounts/{id}/posting-slots replaces the account's weekly times (duplicates
collapse). Posts already scheduled keep their times.
PostingSlotsUpdate.title: PostingSlotsUpdate

PriorityConversation.description: One row of Home's Live Priority Queue (services/priority_queue.py has the rules).
PriorityConversation.title: PriorityConversation

PrivateReplyCreate.description:
POST …/comments/{comment_id}/private-reply: a DM to the commenter, text only (Instagram's
private replies carry no attachments). Instagram's limit is 1,000 bytes and a Facebook Page's
2,000 characters (GR-29); the service checks the account's own limit; this only bounds the body
size.
PrivateReplyCreate.title: PrivateReplyCreate

ProductMessageSend.description:
``product``: one item (``item``). ``product_list``: ``sections`` of items (up to 30 in all,
in up to 10 sections) under a ``header``, which Meta requires for a list.
ProductMessageSend.title: ProductMessageSend

ProductPatch.description: Only the fields sent change. ``variants`` replaces the whole list (see the module doc).
ProductPatch.title: ProductPatch

ProductStep.description:
Send a product from the catalogue: its name, price, stock (when recorded), picture and
link, read when the step runs. With ``variant_id`` that variant; without one, the product's
price, or a short list of its variants. ``intro`` is a line of your own above it.
ProductStep.title: ProductStep

PushConfig.description:
GET /v1/push/config: what the browser needs to subscribe. The web reads the VAPID public
key here rather than from a build-time variable, so one deploy serves any key.
PushConfig.title: PushConfig

PushDevice.description: A registered browser; never its keys.
PushDevice.title: PushDevice

PushPreferences.description:
One switch per push event (models/notifications.PushEvent); all on by default
(models/identity.DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_PREFS).
PushPreferences.title: PushPreferences

PushSubscriptionCreate.description:
POST /v1/me/push-subscriptions: the browser's ``PushSubscription.toJSON()`` (endpoint and
keys) plus the user agent, shown as the device name. Registering an endpoint again updates it
(and moves it to the caller if another user had it: the browser now belongs to them).
PushSubscriptionCreate.title: PushSubscriptionCreate

QueueInfo.description: FR-AUT-10: private replies waiting in the account's 750/hour queue for this automation.
QueueInfo.title: QueueInfo

QuickReply.description: A tap-to-answer option; the flow goes on at ``next`` when it's tapped.
QuickReply.title: QuickReply

QuickReplyOut.description: A quick reply offered with the text (tap first, FR-AUT-21); shown, not tappable, here.
QuickReplyOut.title: QuickReplyOut

RandomizeStep.description: An A/B split: each run takes one path, at random by weight.
RandomizeStep.title: RandomizeStep

RankedPostRow.description:
One post of a ranking. ``label`` is server copy; ``caption`` is the customer's own text:
render it as text.
RankedPostRow.title: RankedPostRow

RankedPostsVisual.description: Posts ranked by one metric, best first (top_posts).
RankedPostsVisual.title: RankedPostsVisual

RefundCreate.description: Refund an order. ``amount_minor`` blank refunds everything not yet refunded.
RefundCreate.title: RefundCreate

ReportAccount.description: A connected account, as the picker and the breakdown name it.
ReportAccount.title: ReportAccount

ReportAccountMetric.description:
An account insight (GR-38's service) for the week against the week before, with a weekly
series. ``figure`` carries the gap reason and days covered.
ReportAccountMetric.title: ReportAccountMetric

ReportMetric.description:
A count or rate for the week, the week before, and the weeks leading up to it (oldest
first, the last point is the week). ``change_pct`` is relative for counts and times; for a
percentage ``change_points`` is the difference in percentage points instead.
ReportMetric.title: ReportMetric

ReportPoint.description: One week of a series: the Monday it starts, and its value (None is a gap).
ReportPoint.title: ReportPoint

RunHints.description:
VIS-11: a structured follow-up on the run before it, instead of free text from the screen.

Two kinds, never mixed: ``range_days`` and/or ``platform`` ask the same question again over
another range or platform (the controls on a visual); ``reply_conversation_ids`` asks for a
draft reply to each of those conversations (VIS-12). Keys and values are whitelisted; the
server words the member's question from them and the planner applies them as if the member had
asked. Conversations must be the workspace's (404 otherwise).
RunHints.title: RunHints

SandboxAccountCreate.description:
Which sandbox account to make (dev and e2e): an Instagram account, a Facebook Page (GR-29)
or a WhatsApp number with approved templates (GR-23). No body makes an Instagram one.
SandboxAccountCreate.title: SandboxAccountCreate

SandboxInbound.description:
A fake Instagram event, or a fake Facebook Page event for a sandbox Page (dev and e2e).
GR-01 adds a referral without a message (an entry link opened, or an ad tapped), a tapped
postback (an ice breaker), an opt-in and a Live comment; a DM can carry an ad referral (its
first message from an ad). GR-06 and GR-07 add a
story reply, a story like (the heart) and a story mention. A Facebook Page takes a DM, a
comment on a post, a referral, a postback and an opt-in; the kinds it doesn't have are
refused (GR-29).

GR-23 adds two kinds for a sandbox WhatsApp number, and lets a ``dm`` be a WhatsApp customer's
message (``from_id`` is their number): ``status`` is a delivery status for the last message we
sent that contact (``delivery_status``, with ``error_code`` and ``error_text`` for a failure),
and ``quality`` a ``phone_number_quality_update`` (``quality_event``, ``tier``).
SandboxInbound.title: SandboxInbound

SavedReplyCreate.description:
The shortcut is what follows ``/`` in the composer: lower case letters, digits, ``-`` and
``_``, unique in the workspace. The body may use ``{first_name}``, ``{username}``, ``{name}``,
``{email}``, ``{phone}`` and a custom field's key; ``{first_name|there}`` names a fallback.
SavedReplyCreate.title: SavedReplyCreate

SavedReplyFill.description: The conversation whose contact the reply is filled for.
SavedReplyFill.title: SavedReplyFill

ScheduleMessagePrefill.description: The conversation's schedule popover (F-06), limited to the reply window.
ScheduleMessagePrefill.title: ScheduleMessagePrefill

ScheduleRequest.description:
POST …/schedule and …/reschedule: at least 5 minutes from now (else 422 on
``publish_at``).
ScheduleRequest.title: ScheduleRequest

ScheduledPost.description: GET …/scheduled-posts/{id} (§5.10 ScheduledPost, UX-SCR-13): the composer's post.
ScheduledPost.title: ScheduledPost

ScheduledPostDraft.description:
POST …/scheduled-posts (a new draft) and PUT …/scheduled-posts/{id} (replace the whole
editable post; the composer autosaves). Everything may be empty on a draft: the checklist says
what is missing. Accounts must be this workspace's (else 422 on ``targets.{i}``), assets this
workspace's post uploads (else 422 on ``asset_ids.{i}``).

On a scheduled post (Update schedule) the saved result must still pass the checklist and
``publish_at`` must be set and at least 5 minutes away (else 422 with every failing field);
its targets stay pending.
ScheduledPostDraft.title: ScheduledPostDraft

ScheduledPostSummary.description: A post in the List view, on the calendar and in bulk results (UX-SCR-04).
ScheduledPostSummary.title: ScheduledPostSummary

ScheduledPostTarget.description: One account the post publishes to (§5.10 ScheduledPost.targets).
ScheduledPostTarget.title: ScheduledPostTarget

Seats.description: Members plus pending invitations against the plan's ``members`` limit (null: unlimited).
Seats.title: Seats

SendStep.description:
A message. With quick replies the flow waits for an answer: a tap goes to that option's
step, anything typed to ``on_text`` (quick replies don't show on desktop).

With ``saved_reply_id`` (GR-21) the text is that saved reply's body, read and filled for the
contact when the step runs, and ``text`` is ignored. A saved reply goes alone: no image,
buttons or quick replies. A deleted reply fails the step.
SendStep.title: SendStep

SentimentDistribution.description:
GET …/analytics/sentiment: comment sentiment for one post, or for comments made in a date
range (optionally one account's). Unanalysed comments are counted, not guessed.

``positive + neutral + negative`` are analysed comments that are not spam; the percentages
are shares of that sum (None when it is 0).
SentimentDistribution.title: SentimentDistribution

SentimentSplit.description:
Messages (customer, received) or comments (not deleted) in the period by sentiment.
``positive + neutral + negative`` are analysed and not spam; the shares are of that sum.
SentimentSplit.title: SentimentSplit

SentimentSummaryVisual.description:
Comment sentiment as one split, with the top topics when the run found them
(sentiment_distribution, comment_topics).
SentimentSummaryVisual.title: SentimentSummaryVisual

SequenceAnalytics.description: A sequence's numbers, computed by the server and cached for a few minutes.
SequenceAnalytics.title: SequenceAnalytics

SequenceBody.description: The whole sequence, as the editor sends it. Saving replaces the steps.
SequenceBody.title: SequenceBody

ShopifyConnectComplete.description: The nonce the OAuth callback put in the Products page's URL (?shopify=…).
ShopifyConnectComplete.title: ShopifyConnectComplete

SiteCrawlInfo.description: GR-35: where a site source's crawl is. Counts are of this site's pages.
SiteCrawlInfo.title: SiteCrawlInfo

SitePage.description: GR-35: one address of a site crawl.
SitePage.title: SitePage

SplitBranch.description: One path of a Split step: the runs that took it, and what happened on the steps after it.
SplitBranch.title: SplitBranch

StepIn.description:
One message. It waits ``delay_seconds`` from the contact's entry or the step before, then
sends ``text`` (while the messaging window is open), or on WhatsApp the approved template.
StepIn.title: StepIn

StepStats.description:
One step's numbers. ``reached`` is the people it ran for plus those it is next for; the
funnel is ``share`` of everyone who entered.
StepStats.title: StepStats

StepVerification.description: R2 (TR-AGT-06): what the verifier read back after a write.
StepVerification.title: StepVerification

StopRules.description:
When to stop: the contact writing (on by default), a tag from ``tag_ids`` being added, a tag
from ``removed_tag_ids`` being taken off, or their lead stage becoming one from the list.
StopRules.title: StopRules

Story.description:
One of the account's live stories, as Instagram lists it. ``id`` is what a story reply
automation is scoped to. ``expires_at`` is 24 hours after it was posted.
Story.title: Story

StoryMention.description:
Someone mentioned the account in their story. ``link_url`` is Instagram's address of the
story and is only given while the story is live (until ``link_expires_at``).
StoryMention.title: StoryMention

TableRow.description:
Cells in the order of the table's columns. Text cells may be the customer's own words:
render them as text.
TableRow.title: TableRow

TableVisual.description: A short table of what a tool listed (VIS-09): at most 10 rows and 6 columns.
TableVisual.title: TableVisual

TargetIn.description: An account to publish to, with an optional caption for it alone.
TargetIn.title: TargetIn

TimeRange.description: Open from ``start`` until ``end`` (the end itself is closed), 24-hour clock.
TimeRange.title: TimeRange

TopPosts.description:
GET …/analytics/top-posts: posts published in the range, ranked by a metric at an age
(each post at the requested age, or at the latest window it has reached when younger).
TopPosts.title: TopPosts

TrendVisual.description:
One series over time (metric_trend, VIS-07). One series only: a second hue waits for the
categorical palette (C-123). Every value, the extremes and the change come from the tool.
TrendVisual.title: TrendVisual

UserTag.description:
An Instagram account tagged on a photo at a point: ``x`` and ``y`` are fractions (0 to 1)
of the photo's width and height from its top left (FR-PUB-07).
UserTag.title: UserTag

UserTagIn.description:
A tag on one of the post's photos (``asset_id`` must be in ``asset_ids``, else 422 on
``user_tags.{i}``); ``username`` with or without "@".
UserTagIn.title: UserTagIn

VariableSpec.description:
One template variable: a contact field (with the text to use when the person has none) or
a fixed text. ``field`` is first_name, name, username, email, phone or a custom field's key.
VariableSpec.title: VariableSpec

VisualPeriod.description: Calendar days in the workspace's zone, both included, with the label the answer uses.
VisualPeriod.title: VisualPeriod

WebhookEndpointWithSecret.description: Create and rotate: the signing secret, shown this once (Standard Webhooks, whsec_…).
WebhookEndpointWithSecret.title: WebhookEndpointWithSecret

WeeklyReport.description:
GET …/reports/weekly: the report for one finished week. ``week_start`` is its Monday in
the workspace's time zone; ``weeks`` lists the Mondays that can be asked for, newest first.
The digest email of that Monday carries the same numbers.
WeeklyReport.title: WeeklyReport

WorkspacePermissions.description:
What the signed-in member may do here. The web app's can() reads this list; it never
keeps a copy of the matrix.
WorkspacePermissions.title: WorkspacePermissions

get.description:
Public, no sign-in: Free, Pro and Max (``available: false`` until R2) with their §1.7
entitlements and Dodo prices (cached 1 h; null when Dodo can't be reached), for the /pricing
page and the upgrade dialog's comparison. The same numbers as GET …/billing.

post.description:
Public, no sign-in (FR-NOT-04 one click): the signed token (notify/unsubscribe.py) turns
the weekly digest off for its member and workspace. Also the target of the email's
List-Unsubscribe-Post (RFC 8058), whose form body is ignored. 404 not_found for a token that
doesn't verify or a membership that no longer exists. Never a GET, so link scanners can't
unsubscribe anyone: the email links to the web's /unsubscribe page, which posts here.

get.description: The current user, provisioned on first sight (TR-AUTH-03), with their workspaces.

delete.description:
Remove this browser's subscription (push turned off). Only the caller's own row is
removed; an unknown endpoint, or another user's, is 204 all the same and changes nothing.

post.description:
Register this browser (F-19), or refresh it: the endpoint is unique, so registering it
again updates its keys, clears a failure count or disabled state, and gives it to the caller.
422 for an endpoint that isn't a browser push service. A user keeps their 10 most recently
used browsers.

get.description:
The VAPID public key the browser subscribes with (TR-FE-09); ``enabled`` is false when
the API has no VAPID keys, and the page shows push as unavailable.
Also remembers this workspace as the user's last one, for /app (F-02).

Automation runs, failed sends, failed webhook deliveries and accounts that need
attention, newest first. ``failures_only`` (the default) leaves out runs that worked.

The writes the agent proposed, soonest to expire first ("Waiting for you"): owners and
admins see every approval, a member those of their own runs. ``status`` ``all`` keeps every
status; ``run_id`` one run's. Approvals past their time are marked expired first.

post.description:
Run the write as proposed, or with edited ``args``, through the normal service (what the
screen would do by hand). 403 forbidden when the caller's role couldn't do it by hand; 404
when it isn't the caller's to see; 409 when it is no longer pending (decided or expired); 422
for edited arguments that don't fit. When the service refuses it (a name taken since, a plan
limit) nothing is saved, the approval stays pending and its ``outcome`` says why.

Say no: nothing is saved. 404 when it isn't the caller's to see; 409 when it is no longer
pending.

get.description:
The workspace's agent mode, capability switches and limits. In R1 the mode is always
read_only and every switch is off.

put.description: R2: replace the policy (owners and admins). 409 for ``autonomous`` until R3.

get.description:
FR-AGT-07 run history, newest first: the caller's runs, or every run for owners and
admins. ``thread_id`` keeps one thread's runs (the Ask panel reverses them into a
conversation); a thread that isn't the caller's lists nothing. ``status`` (repeatable) keeps
runs in those statuses and ``q`` those whose request contains the text, in any case
(Settings → Agent's history filters and search).

post.description:
FR-AGT-01: ask a question. The run is stored ``queued`` with the policy's mode, run_agent
is enqueued (interactive lane, lock ``agent:{run_id}``) and the queued run is returned; nothing
is reserved yet. 404 when ``thread_id`` isn't one of the caller's threads; 402 quota_exceeded
(ai_credits_monthly, with the plan's limit) when the workspace has no AI credits left
(nothing is stored).

get.description:
One run with every step: the tool in plain words, arguments, status, result summary,
verification, latency; the run's credits, model and prompt version (TR-AGT-08).
``visuals``: see schemas/agent.py (empty unless the server has visuals on).

post.description:
Stop at the next step (§9): an unfinished run becomes ``cancelled`` at once and run_agent
stops before its next step or model turn; a step already running finishes and is kept. A
finished run is returned as it is. Only the member who asked, or an owner or admin.

get.description:
The caller's Ask panel threads, most recent activity first (owners and admins too: threads
are personal; other members' runs are in the run history).

post.description:
Mark an auto reply "should not have sent" ("bad"), or clear the mark (null). Only a
decision that sent a reply takes feedback (409 otherwise).

get.description: FR-KB-04, FR-SUG-05, FR-SUG-06: brand voice, takeover period and escalation phrases.

put.description: Replace the whole settings object.

post.description:
Write a caption from a brief, or improve the caption given (422 on ``brief`` or
``caption`` when the one the mode needs is missing). At most 2,200 characters, 30 hashtags
and 20 mentions, so it passes the checklist.

Up to ``count`` (at most 20) hashtags for the caption, none already in it or in
``exclude``.

get.description:
What the account (or every account) did over the range, from its daily readings and the
comment and message tables; ``compare=previous`` adds the period of the same length just
before, with the change in % (worked out here). A day without a reading is a gap, not a zero:
each figure says how many days it has, and is null with the reason when none. Today has no
reading yet. ``metric`` (repeatable) picks metrics; default all. 404 for another workspace's
account.

The post against its account's earlier posts at the same age (TR-AGT-05): the previous
``n`` posts, or (``baseline=range``, which needs ``since`` and ``until``) the posts published
in that range, this post left out. ``same_format`` compares Reels with Reels and feed posts
with feed posts.

Reach, views, likes, comments, shares, saves and engagement rate at ``age`` (FR-ANL-02).
Without ``age``: the latest window the post has reached.

Comment sentiment for one post (``post_id``; the range is then ignored), or for comments
made in the range, optionally on one account's posts.

Posts published in the range ranked by ``metric`` at ``age``, best first; posts without
the metric at that age are left out (``considered`` is the sample size).
Newest first, revoked keys included, with every scope a key can carry.

post.description:
The key is in this response only. 402 entitlement_required on Free (the public API is part
of Pro); 409 at 20 active keys.

delete.description:
Stops the key working at once and removes the REST hooks it subscribed. Revoking a revoked
key changes nothing.

get.description:
The members who can be assigned (with their availability and open conversations) and
whether round-robin is on.

put.description: Turn round-robin on or off: new conversations nobody has go to the next available member.

get.description: Who sent, edited or deleted what, newest first. ``until`` is exclusive.
Every matching automation (no paging); ``q`` searches names and keywords.

post.description: A draft, blank or filled from a template (FR-AUT-12).
Bulk pause from the list (FR-AUT-19).

put.description: The account's automations in their new order (FR-AUT-15).

Replace the whole definition (autosave). Returns overlaps and what activation still needs.
An active automation must stay complete: 422 lists what the change would break.

post.description:
Validate (FR-AUT-02) and entitlements; 422 lists every missing or invalid field. Resuming
an automation that held private replies restarts its account's queue (FR-AUT-10).
A draft copy named "… (copy)".

delete.description: Go back to the message settings; runs on a saved version finish on it.

get.description:
The automation's flow: saved (``source: flow``), or compiled from its message settings
(``legacy``, version 0), with what activation still needs.

put.description:
Save the flow; from now on its steps replace the message settings. A broken graph is
refused (422 with each step's field); an active automation must stay complete; more steps
than the plan allows is a 402 (``flow_steps``, pending PD-5).

get.description:
Per step: reached, sent, delivered, read, taps, link clicks and captures, and each Split
step's results per path, for the last 7, 30 or 90 days (GR-15).
The run log, newest first (FR-AUT-04).
Figures and the daily series for the last 7 or 30 days (FR-AUT-16).

post.description: What would happen for this text; sends nothing.

get.description:
Plan, status, entitlements, usage (AI credits and scheduled posts this period; knowledge
characters, active automations, pending scheduled messages and connected accounts per
platform counted live), trial eligibility (TR-BIL-05) and the paid plans' prices from Dodo
(cached 1 h; a price Dodo can't give now is left out).

post.description:
FR-BIL-04, TR-BIL-06: cancel at the end of the period (Dodo's
cancel_at_next_billing_date). The answer shows ``cancel_at_period_end: true``; the plan stays
until the period ends (subscription.cancelled, then Free). 409 on the Free plan; cancelling
again answers the same.

F-15, TR-BIL-01: a Dodo hosted checkout for ``plan`` with the owner's email, returning to
/w/{slug}/settings/billing?checkout=return, ``metadata.workspace_id`` set, and the 7-day trial
only when eligible (TR-BIL-05). 409 conflict when the workspace already has a paid plan
(active, trialing or on hold): the portal changes it. 422 for ``max`` until R2. 503 when Dodo
isn't configured or doesn't answer. Nothing changes until Dodo's signed webhook arrives.

get.description:
Payment history for owners and admins (admins see billing read-only, §3.1): the
workspace's Dodo payments, newest first (``occurred_at``), paged by ``cursor``. Amounts are
in minor units of ``currency``; ``invoice_url`` is Dodo's, null when Dodo gave none. Rows
arrive from Dodo's signed payment.* webhooks only (TR-BIL-02).

post.description:
FR-BIL-04, TR-BIL-06: a Dodo customer portal session (payment method, invoices), opened
in a new tab. 409 conflict when the workspace has never had a Dodo customer; 503 when Dodo
doesn't answer.

Undo a cancellation before the period ends. 409 unless ``cancel_at_period_end``, or when
Dodo has already ended the plan.

get.description: Newest first, each with its counts.

post.description: Save a draft. Nothing is sent until it is started.

get.description: Whether broadcasts are switched on, what the plan allows this month and Meta's rate card.

post.description:
Who would get it, who is skipped and why, what Meta's rate card says it costs, whether it
fits the plan's recipients and the number's daily limit, and the message with a sample
contact. 402 on a plan without broadcasts; 404 for a number or segment of another workspace;
422 names what doesn't fit the template.

delete.description: Delete a draft, a cancelled or a failed broadcast; 409 for one that was sent.

patch.description: Change a draft or scheduled broadcast; 409 once it has started.

post.description: Stop for good: everyone still waiting is skipped. Messages already handed over still go.

get.description: The audience, by position, with each person's status; failed and skipped ones say why.

post.description: Resume a paused broadcast; 409 while the number's quality is Low.

Send now, or at ``scheduled_at``. 402 without the plan or past the month's recipients, 409
if it has already finished, 422 when no one can be sent to.

get.description: The workspace's schedule (in its time zone), and each account's own when it differs.

put.description:
Replace the workspace's schedule. 422 names each field: an overlapping range, a closing
time before the opening one, an away message left empty, hours switched on with no range.

get.description:
FR-PUB-08: posts, scheduled DMs (the Messages layer) and free posting times from ``from``
to ``to`` (dates in the workspace time zone, both included, at most 42 days: else 422 on
``to``). ``account_ids`` narrows every layer; ``layers`` defaults to all three.

The Comments nav badge: comments from the last 7 days that are waiting for a reply (not
replied to publicly or privately, not spam, hidden or deleted). comment.created and
comment.updated tell the web to fetch it again.

delete.description:
Delete the comment on Instagram (admins). The row keeps ``deleted_at`` and leaves every
list and count; comment.updated (with ``deleted_at`` set) tells open pages to drop it.

post.description:
Hide the comment on Instagram (others no longer see it; the commenter still does).
Hiding a hidden comment returns it as it is.

A DM to the commenter, addressed by the comment: queued as an outbound message in their
conversation (created if needed), which message.* events follow. The answer is the comment
with ``private_reply`` set. Instagram allows one per comment within 7 days: a second is 409
conflict. Idempotency-Key and the read-only 402 as for ``reply_to_comment``.

A public reply under the comment, posted on Instagram before the answer (the comment's
``public_reply`` holds it). The same Idempotency-Key with the same body returns the first
answer and posts nothing more (TR-API-05). 402 quota_exceeded (accounts_per_platform) when
the account is read-only after a downgrade (FR-BIL-07).
Show a hidden comment again.

get.description: In order, with the plan's contact_fields limit.

post.description: 402 quota_exceeded over the plan's contact_fields; 409 for a key in use.

delete.description: The field goes, and its values from every contact.

get.description: Every saved filter, by name.

post.description: 409 for a name in use; 404 for a tag that isn't there; 422 for a field that doesn't exist.

get.description:
Newest activity first. ``tag_id`` repeats: a contact must carry every one. ``q`` matches
part of the name, @username, email or phone; ``marketing_consent`` keeps contacts whose
current consent for that channel is granted. ``active_within_days`` keeps contacts active in
the last N days and ``inactive_for_days`` those with no activity for N days or more (moving
ranges, which a saved segment needs). ``field`` repeats: ``city:pune`` matches a
custom field's value ignoring case, ``city:*`` any value. ``stage`` repeats: a contact in any
of those lead stages (GR-18).

post.description:
Add and remove tags on up to 500 named contacts, or on everyone a filter matches (up to
5,000; a bigger match is a 422 with the count). 404 for an unknown tag.

get.description: How many contacts match the same filters as the list.

The filtered contacts as CSV (the R2 data export), streamed: nothing is stored. A cell a
spreadsheet would read as a formula starts with a quote.

patch.description:
422 lists each value that doesn't fit (an email's shape, a phone without a country code, a
field's type or an unknown field).

post.description: A member records consent given elsewhere, or its withdrawal; the note is the evidence.
Move a lead to any stage; the note is why. The same stage again changes nothing.

get.description: The sequences a contact is in or has been in, with what happened at each step.
Conversations, comments, automation runs, story mentions, consent and tags, newest first.

patch.description:
Archive or unarchive; set or clear the conversation's AI mode override (auto needs a paid
plan: 402 entitlement_required); resume_ai ends a takeover pause (FR-SUG-05).

put.description:
Give the conversation to a member, or to nobody (``user_id`` null). The member is told, and
the change is in the thread, the contact's timeline and the audit log.

get.description: Newest first; next_cursor loads older messages (upward infinite scroll).

post.description:
Queue a reply; it is sent by the worker and progress arrives as message.updated events.

Any member may reply. The same Idempotency-Key with the same body returns the first response
and sends nothing more; with a different body it is 409 idempotency_conflict. 402
quota_exceeded (accounts_per_platform) when the conversation's account is read-only after a
downgrade (FR-BIL-07).

AI Polish (C-063): the member's draft with its grammar and clarity fixed, in the same
language (English, Hindi or Hinglish), meaning and roughly length; it never adds facts,
prices or promises. 1 credit; nothing is stored or sent. 402 quota_exceeded without credits;
